items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That’s the guy that built the truck, Pearlman.

ctx.x: Leroy Pearlman has mentioned that the Wolf Pack once played on a show with Marlene Dietrich.
That’s the guy that built the truck, Pearlman.
He also said the band worked on the same bill as other well-known performers. Do you have any . . .?
